## Projects

- [Pharmacy Management System](https://www.abdullahidrees.com/projects/pharmacy-management-system.html): A Windows Forms application for pharmacy inventory, sales, billing and prescription tracking, backed by SQL Server.
- [Feenion: School Fees Software](https://www.abdullahidrees.com/projects/feenion-school-fees-software.html): A web application for schools to manage invoices and bills and track income, expenses and financial reports.
- [Al Sahraa Landscaping](https://www.abdullahidrees.com/projects/al-sahraa-landscaping.html): A responsive website for a Dubai landscaping company with a services showcase and a client enquiry form.
- [ExoNova Solutions](https://www.abdullahidrees.com/projects/exonova-solutions-website.html): The business website for ExoNova, a software and web design agency, with service listings and a portfolio.
- [International SMM](https://www.abdullahidrees.com/projects/international-smm-panel.html): A social media marketing panel with user dashboards and API access, built with PHP and MySQL.
- [Wander](https://www.abdullahidrees.com/projects/wander-travel-website.html): A travel booking website with destination search, curated tours and itinerary planning.
- [Linked List Address Book](https://www.abdullahidrees.com/projects/linked-list-address-book.html): A contact manager in C++ built on a linked list, with full create, read, update and delete support.
